The user wants Taiwan Traditional Chinese UI strings for an app:
- s1: submit button for feedback form (送出意見)
- s2: settings page button to save changes (儲存變更)
- s3: status text after changes saved (變更已儲存)

Taiwan UI conventions:
- "送出" for submit
- "儲存變更" for save changes (Taiwan uses 儲存, not 保存)
- Status: "變更已儲存" or "已完成儲存變更" — common Taiwan phrasing: "變更已儲存" or "設定已儲存"

Output only JSON object with keys s1, s2, s3.</think>{"s1": "送出意見", "s2": "儲存變更", "s3": "變更已儲存"}
